title: Quenched Quiet Filipino Chicken Biryani
description: A cultured and aerated Filipino dish featuring shio-koji, perfect for curing hangovers, and friendly to ayurvedic tamasic diets. This recipe combines the flavors of the Philippines with the healing properties of shio-koji.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the shio-koji, salt, black pepper, and turmeric, and stir to combine.
Add the jasmine rice and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Fluff the biryani with a fork and serve hot.
